mapper.select: SELECT created_at FROM otp_challenges WHERE phone_hash = #{phoneHash} AND purpose = #{purpose} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE otp_challenges SET status = 'SUPERSEDED' WHERE phone_hash = #{phoneHash} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO otp_challenges (id, phone_hash, phone_enc, code_hash, language, attempts, max_attempts, status, purpose, customer_id, ip, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{phoneHash}, #{phoneEnc}, #{codeHash}, #{language}, 0, #{maxAttempts}, 'ACTIVE', #{purpose}, #{customerId}, CAST(#{ip} AS inet), #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT status, attempts, max_attempts, expires_at, phone_hash FROM otp_challenges WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE otp_challenges SET status = 'VERIFIED', verified_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE otp_challenges SET tap_token_id = #{tapTokenId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE otp_challenges SET status = 'LOCKED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE otp_challenges SET registration_token_hash = #{tokenHash}, registration_expires_at = #{expiresAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: UPDATE otp_challenges SET registration_token_hash = NULL WHERE registration_token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND registration_expires_at > #{now} AND status = 'VERIFIED' RETURNING id AS challenge_id, phone_hash, phone_enc, language
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM otp_challenges WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} OR phone_hash = #{phoneHash}
